headline: Voters mostly don’t like AI and data centers, but neither party seems to have an edge
summary: Poll data reveals 61% of likely voters oppose AI data center construction. The New York Times/Siena University survey highlights widespread public disapproval. Neither political party holds a clear advantage on this issue.

headline: Microsoft announces Windows and Surface event for October 7th
summary: Microsoft will host a Windows and Surface event on October 7th in San Francisco. The company plans to discuss the future of Windows and new Surface devices. Local AI's role in upcoming computing advancements will be a key focus.

headline: What if social media isn’t hurting kids?
summary: A new article questions the popular belief that social media is harming children. It challenges the premises of Jonathan Haidt's bestselling book, 'The Anxious Generation'. The piece explores alternative perspectives on youth mental health and digital use.

headline: Kia’s electric van lineup is getting more interesting with reveal of PV7
summary: Kia is expanding its electric vehicle range with the introduction of the PV7 electric van. Minivan sales are on the rise, up 21% in 2025, suggesting a comeback for the segment. The PV7 aims to appeal to consumers looking for practical, eco-friendly alternatives to SUVs.

headline: Marvel's Wolverine Offers Up a Canonical Explanation for Why Logan's Costume Regenerates
summary: Marvel's Wolverine game provides a canonical reason for Logan's costume regenerating. This explanation details how his outfit repairs itself, much like his healing factor. It adds a new piece of lore to the Wolverine mythos.

headline: HBO Boss All But Confirms The Last of Us Show Will End With Season 3
summary: HBO's CEO suggests that 'The Last of Us' series is likely to conclude after its third season. Showrunner Craig Mazin has reportedly planned for a three-season run. This indicates a definitive ending for the critically acclaimed adaptation.

headline: Warner Bros. Reportedly Regrets Torching Zack Snyder's DC Universe and Battling With Him on Justice League
summary: A Warner Bros. executive reportedly expressed regret over past conflicts with Zack Snyder. The studio's decision to alter his DC universe vision is now a source of regret. This suggests a reevaluation of their handling of the Justice League and Snyder's creative input.

headline: Walmart Just Discounted Over a Dozen Nintendo Switch Games, Plus Get an Extra $10 With This Secret Coupon
summary: Walmart is offering significant discounts on more than a dozen Nintendo Switch games. Shoppers can also use a secret coupon for an additional $10 off. This sale presents a great opportunity for Switch owners to expand their game library.

headline: Baby 'cot cams' plan after inquiry finds Lucy Letby crimes could have been prevented
summary: Plans are being 'urgently' developed for live-streaming cameras in baby cots. This follows an inquiry into Lucy Letby's crimes, which concluded they could have been prevented. The measure aims to enhance safety and monitoring in neonatal units.

headline: All support acts on Ed Sheeran's US tour quit after Macklemore dropped
summary: All support acts have withdrawn from Ed Sheeran's US tour. This comes after Macklemore was removed from the lineup for pro-Palestinian statements. Sheeran stated he was not responsible for Macklemore's removal.

headline: Dan Thomas resigns as Reform Wales leader after arrest on suspicion of assault
summary: Dan Thomas has resigned as leader of Reform Wales following his arrest. Gwent Police confirmed his arrest on suspicion of assault. Thomas asserts his innocence, stating he has done nothing wrong.

headline: Former England footballer Raheem Sterling admits dangerous driving on motorway before crash
summary: Former England winger Raheem Sterling has admitted to dangerous driving. He crashed his Lamborghini into motorway barriers back in May. The admission precedes further legal proceedings regarding the incident.
